d1764.Raw_Article: 1764 Ta. kuyil koel, Indian cuckoo, Eudynamis honorata ; (kuyilv-, kuyiṉṟ-) to call, whoop, halloo; utter, tell; kuyiṟṟu (kuyiṟṟi-) to tell, utter. Ma. kuyil, kur̤il Indian cuckoo, Cuculus or E. orientalis. Ka. kukil cuckoo; vb. to cry as a cuckoo; (Kumt.; U.P.U.) kūgula cuckoo. Tu. kōgilè, kōjilè , (B-K.) kuyilů id. Kuwi (Mah.) kuhu paṭa id. / Cf. Skt. kokila- Indian cuckoo; cf. Pkt. kuhila- id. DED(S, N) 1470.
